evidence.quote: A good example of red blue ocean drop shipping would be selling to a untapped European country. Taking a winning product that everyone else is selling and putting it there, you will have pretty much 100% success rate cuz people aren't that different. They like the same products in Europe, but they haven't been shown it to.
